frontmatter.name: web-design
frontmatter.description: Design, build and improve production web UI — layout, visual hierarchy, typography, colour systems, responsive behaviour, components, landing pages, accessibility, SEO structure and performance. Use for any website or UI work: building a new page, redesigning an existing one, polishing a layout, reviewing a design, or judging whether a redesign actually improved anything. Project-agnostic; reads the project's own design system first.
